title: Sweetness and Lightning
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Math teacher Kouhei Inuzuka is raising his kindergarten daughter Tsumugi alone six months after his wife's death, mostly on ready-made meals. A lonely student, Kotori Iida, whose celebrity-chef mother is often away, invites them to cook together at her mother's restaurant, and shared home-cooked meals become the heart of a new kind of family (Wikipedia; ANN; Kodansha blurb via AniList).
life_message: Cooking and eating together heals grief and turns lonely people into family.

content.note: Kotori's fear of knives; Tsumugi's breakdown (Wikipedia; ANN).
ANN notes 'one small indication' of a student crush on the teacher; he sees her only as a student (ANN; MU Romantic Subplot).
Grief after a mother's death and a lonely, divorced household (Wikipedia; ANN; AniList Tragedy 60).
Recipes and knife use with a young child; adult supervision shown (Wikipedia).
Tsumugi's love of a magical-girl show and its mascot (Wikipedia).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Family and chosen family at the core (ANN; MU Father and Daughter).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Teacher and student cook as equals in the kitchen (Wikipedia).

folkways.japan: Kyara-ben, home cooking and coworkers' understanding of a father leaving early reflect Japanese family and workplace norms (ANN).

delivery.evidence: ANN: themes shown through Tsumugi's breakdown and art, though the idea that food tastes better with family is stated outright.
delivery.note: A gentle family story whose message is carried by scenes of cooking and eating, with no antagonist.

winners_losers: The Inuzukas and Kotori all find comfort and connection; there are no villains. Sympathy goes to care and shared meals.
